relevance.rationale: Gelca-Nagasato: explicit factoring relations for the Kauffman bracket skein module of a twist-knot exterior, written in the basis x^i y^j of Bullock-Lofaro, using curves decorated by characters of irreducible SL(2,C) representations; along the way they isolate a 'minimal relation' in the KBSM which, on specializing the Kauffman variable to t = -1, becomes the defining polynomial of the SL(2,C) character variety of the twist knot. This is stage one of computing the noncommutative A-polynomial for twist knots. Relevance is real but bounded: the corpus's AJ front (prop:phi-q-aj-machinery-identification, and the concrete figure_eight_aj_operator.py / aj_figure_eight_certificate.py) already has the 4_1 operator by another route, and 4_1 is a twist knot -- so the t = -1 specialization is usable as an independent construction of the same character-variety polynomial the complex-volume path relies on, not as something the corpus lacks. Supporting, with a genuine cross-check, not core.

keyResults.locator: final section (the minimal relation at t = -1)
keyResults.statement: The minimal relation in the Kauffman bracket skein module of a twist-knot exterior specializes, at t = -1, to the defining polynomial of the SL(2,C) character variety of that twist knot.
keyResults.useForFolio: An independent skein-theoretic construction of the 4_1 character-variety polynomial that the corpus's complex-volume/character-variety path and the AJ operator both presuppose -- usable as a cross-check on that polynomial.
